title: Designing and Evaluating Multi-Chatbot Interface for Human-AI Communication: Preliminary Findings from a Persuasion Task
reasoning: The paper focuses on the design and evaluation of a multi-chatbot interface and its effectiveness in persuading users to donate to charities. While the task (charitable giving) has a moral component, the paper's focus is on communication effectiveness and human-computer interaction rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, spiritual, or ethical systems.
